bonus.name: -FAQ-
bonus.description:
{"Description":"

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Question Answer
What currency do you accept? We only accept AUD (Australian Dollar).
How do I create an account? Click the "REGISTER" button on the homepage to sign up. Once registered, click "DEPOSIT" to add funds and "WITHDRAW" to cash out.
Can I register multiple accounts? No, creating multiple accounts is strictly prohibited. If this rule is violated, your account will be restricted, and your credits will be forfeited.
What are the deposit and withdrawal limits? - Minimum deposit: AUD5
- Minimum withdrawal: AUD30 (excluding bonuses)
- All deposits require a 1x Rollover (Total Bet).
- No daily withdrawal limit.
Can I deposit again if I still have balance? To avoid confusion with bonus rules, you must use all your funds first before making another deposit. You can deposit again once your balance is below AUD1 or after withdrawing funds.
What do Rollover and Turnover mean? - Rollover: The total amount wagered in games.
- Turnover: The final remaining credit required to make a withdrawal.
Can I claim multiple bonuses at the same time? No, you can only claim one promotion, bonus, rebate, commission, Angpau, etc. Bonuses cannot be combined.
Why do some game platforms disappear at times? For maintenance and system upgrades, some game platforms may be temporarily removed. They will return once maintenance is complete.
I've completed the rollover requirements. Why am I unable to withdraw? If you've completed the rollover requirements, exit the game completely and allow the system time to update your progress. Once the rollover progress bar is full, withdrawals will be available.

We appreciate your time in reviewing our FAQ.
